# BlogSphere

> BlogSphere is an independent blog publishing practical guides on technology, business, home decor, health & fitness, and making money online, in English, French, and Spanish.

## Key pages

- Home: https://blogsphere.info/
- Technology: https://blogsphere.info/Technology
- Business: https://blogsphere.info/Business
- Home Decor: https://blogsphere.info/Home-Decor
- Health & Fitness: https://blogsphere.info/Health-Fitness
- Make Money Online: https://blogsphere.info/Make-Money-Online
- Health Tools (BMI, BMR, TDEE, macros, hydration, ideal weight): https://blogsphere.info/Health-Tools
- About: https://blogsphere.info/about.html
- Contact: https://blogsphere.info/contact.html

## Content

- All articles: https://blogsphere.info/sitemap.xml
- Article pages use the form https://blogsphere.info/article?id=<slug>
- The public article feed is available at https://blogsphere.info/api/public-data

## Notes

- Articles are written for readers in the UK, USA, France, and Spain, and include buying guides, how-to instructions, and price ranges in local currency where relevant.
- The site is a static frontend with a small API backend; there is no paywall and no account is needed to read articles.
